Team —

Finance ran the mid-week integrity check and we have ~18 opportunities in the forecast that are showing stage drift or missing close windows (high risk for Q3 commit). We need a quick sprint to either: finalize a firm commit (update stage to "Commit" and confirm close date) or mark the opp for cleansing/archive.

Quick asks:
- Owners: claim the opps assigned to you in the attached OrphanList.csv and confirm in HubSpot by EOD Thursday.
- If you are waiting on procurement or legal from the customer, update the Stage -> "Procurement" with a best-estimate close date and add the procurement owner in the HubSpot notes.
- Mark any deals that are >90 days without contact as "Archive" candidate and add a one-liner why.

I've attached a short checklist (CloseWindowChecklist.xlsx) with the fields Finance needs for commit: final PO size, expected invoice month, legal gate status, and primary contact.

This is a high-visibility sprint: Finance will lock forecast entries Friday morning. Please prioritize claims and updates. Ping me if you need a two-line blurb to share with the customer.

Thanks —
Priya
